witness.branch: Stopped vehicle on adjacent paved shoulder
witness.quote: parked or stopped upon the traveled portion of a highway or shoulder adjacent thereto
witness.reason: The fixed stop-or-stand task on a paved shoulder supports a stopped-vehicle witness if that shoulder adjoins a qualifying highway.
required_context: Construct an actual stopped interval on the paved shoulder adjacent to the highway.
Establish installed lamps, actual illumination, front white-or-amber and rear red output, and visibility from 500 feet in each required direction.
Establish vehicle classification and exclusions, highway dedication and public vehicular access, shoulder adjacency, actual placement and stopped interval.
Establish vehicle classification and highway status.
Identify passing traffic and the closest vehicle side; retain installation geometry and practicability circumstances without choosing an 'as near as practicable' cutoff.
Identify the separate other vehicle and establish its position, motion and relationship to passing traffic.
Obtain evidence concerning insufficient light to reveal persons or objects within 1,000 feet without selecting an illumination threshold.
Obtain the required insufficient-light, lamp inventory, color, 500-foot visibility and installation evidence.
Record attendance, occupancy and any loading or unloading activity; preserve the unresolved meaning of stopped in this provision.
Retain the unresolved NRS 484D.100 timing reference; do not substitute civil night.
Retain unresolved statutory timing and meaning of stopped; do not infer either solely from the task annotation.
The appended equipment requirement applies to every vehicle without an express temporal limitation; the incorporated NRS 482.029 definition remains unavailable.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor_vehicle_driver supplies a qualifying vehicle subject; loading-related exclusion from parking does not independently eliminate the alternative stopped condition.

targeted_requirements.rationale: Record attendance as context while retaining both forms of vehicle coverage.
